name: Gate 4 Assessment, Approval and Reports
required_scope: Consume only a current shared S13 result and rerun S13 from the exact local inputs before assessment.
Classify the System Portfolio Assessment as Eligible, Eligible with Escalation, Review Required, Not Eligible, or Not Evaluated using a fixed priority order.
Keep the Partner Decision separately owned and limited to Pending, Approved, Modified, Rejected, or Deferred.
Bind completed approval records to a deterministic assessment hash and the total-issuer constraint ceiling.
Generate bilingual One-Page, Full Report, Evidence Appendix, and Validation Report outputs from one validated contract.
Never describe the constraint-based maximum as a suggested, recommended, target, approved, or optimal position.
Never place or transmit a trade automatically.

system_assessment_state_machine.not_evaluated: Invalid, incomplete, stale, changed, or non-reproducible S13 or Gate 3 inputs.
system_assessment_state_machine.not_eligible: A required condition is breached or no positive incremental capacity remains.
system_assessment_state_machine.review_required: A non-required but decision-relevant Warning or Missing item remains unresolved.
system_assessment_state_machine.eligible_with_escalation: Required constraints pass, but reviewed constraint or Gate 3 escalations require Partner acknowledgement.
system_assessment_state_machine.eligible: Required constraints pass with positive capacity and no unresolved review or escalation item.

approval_requirements: Designated Partner identity, timestamp, and rationale.
Minimum and maximum range within the total-issuer constraint ceiling.
Exact acknowledgement of all active escalation IDs.
partner_decision_controls.invalid_completed_record: The submitted state remains visible, but the effective decision becomes PENDING with blocking reason codes.

hash_and_integrity_controls: The assessment-input fingerprint excludes only the mutable Partner decision record.
The assessment hash binds the stable S13 analytical payload, Gate 3 identity, candidate identity, input fingerprint, and System Assessment.
Volatile Gate 3 recheck timestamps are excluded from the analytical hash; check status, evidence, and every substantive field remain included.
The local runner verifies the full private bundle and Gate 3 identity did not change during the S14 run.
S14 independently reproduces the final S13 ceiling and binding constraints before issuing an assessment.
One-Page and Full Report display the same assessment hash and consume the same contract.

report_contract.one_page: Direct decision highlights, System Assessment, Partner Decision, constraint ceiling, binding constraint, escalation list, decision boundary, and next action.
report_contract.full_report: Executive decision, complete constraint matrix, readable per-constraint formula audit, Partner decision record, and decision boundaries.
report_contract.evidence_appendix: Stable evidence IDs, exact values, source objects, source fields, S13 hash, assessment hash, and input fingerprint.
report_contract.validation_report: Contract validation, analytical checks, Hard Stops, Warnings, evidence links, and renderer no-recalculation control.

privacy_boundary: Real portfolio inputs and S14 Markdown outputs remain inside the repo-external private workspace.
Private output files use secure atomic writes and mode 0600.
The terminal prints no private portfolio values, policy limits, approved ranges, or private paths.
Public PDF generation accepts SYNTHETIC_PUBLIC_EXAMPLE only.
Public manifests contain only public filenames and file hashes, not private absolute paths.
Direct private PDF writes remain prohibited and require the separate sanitizer workflow.

synthetic_acceptance.interpretation: Synthetic values verify the interface and controls only; they are not real fund facts, a recommended position, Partner approval, or an investment action.

scope_boundary: Eligible is a policy-constraint status, not a buy instruction or investment recommendation.
The System Assessment never creates an approved or recommended position range.
Only a valid Partner-owned record can display an approved range, and that range remains subject to separate implementation controls.
S14 does not transmit a decision to a broker, order-management system, or external service.
Synthetic PDF reports must not be represented as real portfolio analysis.
Phase D completion does not authorize private data to enter Git or an external model.

exact_next_starting_point.name: S13-S14 Integrated Acceptance and Main Promotion
exact_next_starting_point.first_action: Re-run the frozen S13-S14 acceptance set from the implementation commit, confirm the completion record, and request explicit authorization before merging or pushing Phase D to main.
